messages:
Maria M.: Heads up — finalizing booth plan for Ember Alley meetup on Thurs. Need to lock swag, poster print, and greenroom slots. Who can take courier pickup on Wed 3pm?
Ajay S.: I can do courier pickup Wed 3pm. How many boxes?
Leah E.: Thanks Ajay. 3 boxes + one poster tube. Also need mic check for demo laptop — AV needs HDMI adapter.
Priya G.: @Leah we'll bring a USB-C→HDMI + dongle kit. Who's on demo rotation?
Camila: Volunteer list: Maria (10-11), Ryan (11-1), Camila (1-3). Can shift if needed. Posting signup now: https://tiny.redwood/signup
Ryan - SDR: Quick ask — standard lead flow? Want to route scan QR leads into SF-tailored campaign.
Maria M.: Yes Ryan: QR -> HubSpot form -> tag 'ember-alley-2026' -> assign to SDR queue 'west-sales'. We'll add 'interest' dropdown for benchmark webinar invite. @Priya can you confirm form fields?
Priya G.: Confirm. Fields: name, email, company, role, interest (demo/benchmark/webinar), notes. We'll add utm_source param parsing.
Tom O.: Speaker intake: we have 2 lightning slots left. @Camila any last-minute submissions? Need bios and slides by Tue EOD.
Camila: I've got one submission from Anya (LLM infra). She sent bio; slides pending. I'll chase.
Maria M.: Swag inventory: 500 stickers, 200 tee shirts (mixed sizes), 300 postcard quick-starts. Recommend move 100 postcards + 20 tees to concierge table for walkups.
Leah E.: :thumbsup: Sounds good. Also we added a 'Benchmark one-pager' — printer says bleed margin ok? Sample spec:
```
print_spec: 8.5x11 in, bleed 0.125in, CMYK, 300dpi
```
Deploy-bot: Courier scheduled: FedEx pickup Wed 15:00, tracking 123456789. Storage: Booth Supply A.
Maria M.: Thanks. Can someone post the run-of-show for volunteers and greenroom times? Need quick 2-min huddle before each slot.
Camila: Posting run-of-show now: https://tiny.redwood/run-of-show — I'll be onsite 9:30 for setup.
Ryan - SDR: Also can we add 'webinar invite' checkbox to post-demo follow-up email template? I'll draft and share.
Priya G.: I'll wire the QR -> default follow-up email to include webinar invite when interest=benchmark.
Maria M.: Perfect. Last note: launch post schedule — we'll publish a day-after post summarizing benchmarks + demo clip. @Ajay can you schedule socials?
Ajay S.: Will schedule on Buffer for Fri 10am. I'll include snapshot, link to webinar signup, and CTA for trial.
Maria M.: :wave: Thanks everyone. If anything urgent ping me.
